description: Search the scored RWA / tokenization / family-office signal feed. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Returns signals with intent score (0–100), tier, region, entity, summary and source URL, plus total_matching.

q.description: Free text matched against title, summary, entity name and tags.

region.description: Region code: CH, EU, UK, US, APAC, MENA or Global. Country names like 'Switzerland' are accepted.

since_days.description: Only signals published in the last N days.
